title: zrl's manifestation is gone; the tick can be closed as fixed
body:
zrl reported that below 48 cells a child row's columns shifted by its 3-cell indent in the old table. The redesigned dashboard has no child indentation in its group rows (groups make row adjacency meaningless), so the defect can no longer occur anywhere in the watch; zrl can be closed against this commit.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_view.go dashboardRowLine (no ParentTickID handling); old behaviour pinned in git history internal/cli/watch_view.go@base dashboardTable
